title: The generating function of A348410 in OEIS using the diagonal method and another sequence (A001008) from OEIS
summary: $a_n=[x^n](1-x)^{-n}(1-x^2)^{-n}$ is the sequence A348410 in the Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences. Using a method from Hautus and Klarner from 1971 and the software \textsf{Gfun} we find an algebraic equation for the generating function $g(z)=\sum_na_nz^n$. The second identity uses the \emph{generalized binomial series}, popularized in the textbook \emph{Concrete mathematics}.
